title: Why AI Design Converged on the Same Scaffold
description:
Every breakthrough in AI looks different on the surface. Underneath, the field keeps converging on the same reusable scaffold.

This cinematic brief follows the transition from handcrafted architectures to residual scaffolds, portable transformer blocks, and the compute recipes that now dominate design.

The goal is not to recap the whole essay. It is to give new viewers one strong structural claim: modern AI progress kept accelerating because the field stopped redesigning the whole machine and started reusing a stable scaffold that could absorb scale, specialization, and new workloads.
